label: rare, token-specific blip in copy phase of length-9 sequences (recall 2-3 / 7-8)
explanation: Very sparse and weak (0.028% of steps, max activation 0.008). Only active in the copy phase, and 97% of mass comes from L=9 sequences, at steps t=11,12 (recall_idx 2,3) and t=16,17 (recall_idx 7,8, the last two outputs). It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or for L<=7. Inputs 3, o, g, q, z, x are over-represented, and prev_tok q/c/1 are enriched. These context conditions are necessary-ish (the predicate keeps about 80% of mass) but nowhere near sufficient: precision stays at 2-6% even after adding token and prev-token conditions, so which specific sequences trigger it was not captured. Magnitude is highest at recall_idx 8 and 3 for L=9, which was checked from the profile tables.
